title: Safari Baby Shower
description: A “wild one is on the way” banner over a guest-book table, with a greenery garland laid along the cloth and wooden animal cutouts scattered for guests to sign. The seated tables carry it through in sage and gold — raffia placemats, wood-slice risers, and safari-print plates with a table number set into the centre.
